title: The Last Free Path
subtitle: A material record of learning to leave

cover.alt: Three adult forearms converge above a workbench path beside contained mineral-blue water, blank pages, a dismantled brass interface, and a latched daylight door.

plates.title: Slate Row
plates.caption: Rain shortened the time Arion thought he had. Beneath Slate Row, each correction shifted the danger into another home.
plates.materialNote: Wet connected masonry, rough timber shores, Arion's wrapped hand, and Akamoto inspecting the roof keep the scene at street scale.
plates.alt: Adult Arion stands in rain before connected damaged row houses while Akamoto examines the roof structure behind him.

plates.title: The rain record
plates.chapter: Chapter 2 · The voice removed from rain
plates.caption: Mera kept one vial dry while rain soaked her coat. The silence sealed inside it was the only part of the morning she could still attribute.
plates.materialNote: The rain stays physical; the papers and tags stay blank; the single capped blue vial remains dry inside the wet coat.
plates.alt: Mera records evidence beneath a station awning with rain outside, blank papers and vessel tags, and one capped blue vial protected inside her coat.

plates.title: Correct instrument
plates.caption: The cuff closed past Emilia's second joint before she could find the smooth stop plate. She recorded the failed reach beside the passing result.
plates.materialNote: Three passive inspection windows, a fine driver, and a rough manual side plate show the release as an added mechanical part.
plates.alt: Emilia uses a fine driver on a rough manual side plate beside three passive glass inspection windows on a brass instrument.

plates.title: The shared breach
plates.chapter: Editorial safety study · The hall failure
plates.caption: Three hands held the same broken line. Mera took the last prism charge through a wet hand; Emilia kept memory and current apart; Arion kept the cable off the floor.
plates.materialNote: Exactly three hands meet at one dry severed cable while a raised curb keeps physical water away from the exposed copper.
plates.alt: Three hands share one cable repair: a wrapped hand braces stone, one hand holds dry insulation, and a yellow-cuffed hand operates the release while water stays behind a curb.
plates.frameNote: Editorial safety study. Chapter 6 puts all three hands on the broken line, with Mera's wet hand grounding the last prism charge into the basin; this image moves the water behind a curb and redistributes the contact.

plates.title: A beautiful weight
plates.caption: Above twelve participants, the ceiling passed weight from rib to rib. At station four, Nara's boots showed where the design stopped sharing it.
plates.materialNote: The twelve adults include students and an older civic bridge reader; only Nara's pair of boots sinks into the warm stone.
plates.alt: Twelve adult participants stand beneath an elegant load-sharing ceiling while Nara's boots sink into softened stone at the central station.

plates.title: A manual door
plates.caption: The certified collar lay in pieces while Akamoto worked the shutter and Emilia rested the unfastened brass tongue against the buried face. Then the stone withdrew toward an unlit stair.
plates.materialNote: The image renders the stripped-control principle as a timber threshold; its latch, inert collar, and directional corridor daylight remain entirely physical.
plates.alt: A worn timber door opens inward on an ordinary corridor while a removed brass control collar hangs inert beside the manual latch.
plates.frameNote: Editorial mechanism study, not literal architecture. The manuscript's buried door is stone, withdraws inward toward an unlit stair, and bears three authority impressions.

plates.title: The borrowed method
plates.caption: Arion held Mera's possible return route for one interval. The lodged movement returned through his already-injured hand, and two tight fingers closed farther.
plates.materialNote: Arion's splinted fingers press the stone; Emilia covers the brass route mechanism; Mera stands beyond the water-framed opening.
plates.alt: Arion braces a splinted contracted hand against stone while yellow-cuffed Emilia covers a brass route mechanism and Mera stands beyond framed physical water.

plates.title: Foundation holds
plates.caption: Arion lifted his hand and the visible mortar held. Mera kept the three folds apart beneath her coat while Emilia watched the bowed brass.
plates.materialNote: The still life brings the wrapped hand, fresh mortar, three dry folds, bowed brass, and thinning physical water into one evidence study.
plates.alt: A wrapped hand lifts above a fresh mortar seam beside three separate blank folded records, one pencil, bowed brass, and a thin physical water flow.
plates.frameNote: Editorial still life, not a literal object arrangement. In the manuscript, Mera keeps all three folds separated beneath her coat rather than laying them beside the repair.

plates.title: The final record
plates.caption: Mera, Emilia, and Arion signed separate pages. A pencil, a bent key, and a chipped cup kept the wind from lifting them off the unrepaired table.
plates.materialNote: Three visually blank pages lie across the table crack beside a pencil, bent key, and chipped cup.
plates.alt: Three unlike blank pages, a pencil, bent key, and chipped cup rest on an unrepaired table while Arion, Mera, and Emilia sit blurred behind it.
plates.frameNote: Narrative scene. The pages are visually blank in the artwork to avoid invented legible writing; the manuscript establishes all three signatures.
